family_title_en: Read two-syllable words: silent e, vowel team, r-controlled

stages.ix_title: Read two-syllable words: silent e, vowel team, r-controlled

prompt.en: Which word has the same pattern?

what_to_do.ko: bedtime, cookie, sister 중 하나를 누르세요.

roots: Always use exactly these choices in this order: bedtime, cookie, sister.
bedtime means silent e and answer index 0. cookie means vowel team and answer index 1. sister means r-controlled and answer index 2.
The stem is exactly one two-syllable word. Never use bedtime, cookie, or sister as the stem.
Silent e is a vowel, then a consonant, then e. A vowel team includes ai, ay, ea, ee, ie, oa, ow, oo, ou, oi, oy, au, aw, ew, and igh. R-controlled is ar, er, ir, or, ur, or ore.
Each stem has only one of those patterns. The e in ore is not silent e. A consonant plus le is not silent e.
Never use a word that mixes two patterns, such as teacher, outside, notebook, birthday, flower, or weather.
Do not use a stem that shares a topic with one anchor: no family words, no food words, and no bed, sleep, or night words.
Every stem has exactly two syllables. Do not use a one-syllable word or a three-syllable word.
Tier 3 stems should look like the wrong anchor at first, such as a hidden silent e or a final e that is really ore.
Stems and choices are whole words only. No sound symbols, no brand names, and no real person names.
Do not reuse a gold stem. Each new item needs its own two-syllable word.

tier_rules.1: Easy two-syllable words whose pattern is obvious next to the anchor: inside with bedtime, looking with cookie, and winter with sister.
tier_rules.2: The pattern is true but not a copy of the anchor spelling. Use tadpole with bedtime, rainbow with cookie, and garden with sister.
tier_rules.3: Near misses. baseball hides silent e in the first part and still matches bedtime. before ends in e but ore is r-controlled, so it matches sister. heavy and ready still match cookie.

silent_e.en: Silent e makes the vowel say its name. It may be at the end or inside the word. Match bedtime.
silent_e.ko: 묵음 e는 모음이 이름을 말하게 합니다. 끝이나 안에 있을 수 있습니다. bedtime을 누르세요.

vowel_team.en: Two vowels side by side make one sound, even if they are not oo. Match cookie.
vowel_team.ko: 나란히 있는 모음은 oo가 아니어도 한 소리입니다. cookie를 누르세요.

r_controlled.en: If r follows the vowel, match sister. A final e can still belong to that r spelling.
r_controlled.ko: 모음 뒤에 r이 있으면 sister와 같습니다. 끝의 e도 그 r 철자일 수 있습니다.
